name: Harley-Davidson FXR
engine: 80 cu in air-cooled V-twin (Shovelhead early, Evolution from 1984), one carb, rubber mounted
intro: The rubber-mounted Harley people love for its handling. Check the frame and the usual Evo leaks.

E: Look closely for frame cracks around the engine mounts.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Frame and primary
known.what: Inspect for frame cracks around the engine mounts and check the primary chain and clutch.
